# Why does my QIF file import with the wrong dates?

> Free QIF checker: finds why a QIF file imports with the wrong month, twice, or not at all (no !Type header, missing ^, mixed date order, bad amounts, unbalanced splits), with line numbers, and writes a repaired file. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
